name: Chestnut Hill Square
summary: Chestnut Hill Square is an upscale outdoor lifestyle center in Newton, Massachusetts, offering a sophisticated mix of retail, dining, fitness, and medical services. Located in the prestigious Chestnut Hill area, this modern shopping destination caters to affluent Boston-area residents seeking quality shopping and lifestyle amenities in an attractive open-air setting.
demographics: Chestnut Hill Square attracts an affluent, educated demographic from the greater Boston area, particularly from Newton, Brookline, and surrounding suburbs. The primary visitor base consists of upper-middle-class families and professionals aged 30-65 with household incomes exceeding $100,000, drawn to the center's upscale retail mix and convenient location near prestigious neighborhoods. The trade area includes a high concentration of college-educated residents who value quality shopping experiences, health and wellness amenities, and diverse dining options, with shopping patterns reflecting a preference for both everyday convenience and specialty retail.
description: Chestnut Hill Square is a premier outdoor lifestyle shopping center located at 200 Boylston Street in the prestigious Chestnut Hill neighborhood of Newton, Massachusetts. This modern retail destination offers a carefully curated mix of shopping, dining, health, and entertainment options designed to serve the discerning tastes of Boston's western suburbs. The center features a diverse tenant lineup spanning fashion retailers, specialty shops, fitness facilities, medical services, and an array of restaurants and dining establishments, all arranged in an attractive open-air setting. With its convenient location and comprehensive amenities including guest services and ample parking, Chestnut Hill Square has established itself as a go-to destination for both everyday needs and leisure activities. The center's commitment to creating a complete lifestyle experience is evident in its thoughtful organization into distinct categories—Shop, Dine, Play, and Health—making it easy for visitors to find exactly what they're looking for while enjoying the vibrant atmosphere of this well-maintained shopping destination.
